original_test_intent: Verify that the BMC reports correct per-slot DIMM identity, presence/health status, part number, memory/base-module type and operating speed for the approved population.
original_method: Bind SUT/BMC and slot topology, collect supported read-only BMC memory resources or Web UI, obtain same-host SMBIOS/SPD data, normalize presence/status/type/speed semantics, and compare every populated and expected empty slot to the recipe.
manual_activity: If memory inventory is UI-only, an operator must capture all slots; otherwise the agent can perform the read-only collection after schema, slot map and recipe are supplied.
required_inputs: Documented memory inventory endpoint or UI path
Approved per-slot population and part numbers
safety_requirements: Never substitute sensors for DIMM inventory
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw BMC memory records or operator UI capture
Normalize and compare all listed fields per slot
Report without changing memory settings or deciding verdict
engineer_actions: Supply vendor schema, slot map and recipe

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Completely inapplicable: SDR/sensor lists and SEL_InfoErr_Full evidence belong to duplicate row 765 and do not expose DIMM inventory fields.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the supported read-only BMC memory inventory/API or approved Web UI plus same-host SMBIOS/SPD; do not invent an ipmitool sensor mapping.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Name, Status, Part number, Memory Type, Base module type, Operating speed MHz and 5/5-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a stable slot-keyed comparison across BMC, SMBIOS/SPD and recipe, retaining raw values and explicit speed/status normalization.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds independent inventory corroboration and empty/failure semantics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; every listed field and expected slot remains required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SPD access may be incomplete and operating speed can differ legitimately from module rating.

project_override_considerations: A project may accept supported API evidence for the data fields, but must retain Web UI capture if visual presentation itself is a required checkpoint.
expected_evidence: Approved population and normalized field comparison
No settings/log changes or hardware PASS claim

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1487 consistently defines DIMM inventory. Duplicate row 765 is isolated by row/hash/variant and its sensor/SEL workflow remains separate.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The schema, slot map and expected population are finite inputs; their absence requires package/user confirmation.

review_improvement: Eliminates duplicate-code sensor contamination and makes the DIMM result a per-slot, independently corroborated inventory comparison.
independent_technical_reasoning: The read is low impact, but the supplied command is unrelated and the vendor schema, topology and acceptance mapping are missing. These finite dependencies make REQUIRES more accurate than FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
